text: Andy Burnham was formally asked by King Charles III to form a government and accepted the appointment as U.K. prime minister. Keir Starmer resigned. Government authority transferred through the existing parliamentary process. Financial market pricing remained active during the leadership transition.

meta.note: Market reactions and announced policy positions are separate structural events.

text: Houthi forces declared a maritime embargo against Saudi Arabia effective immediately. Bab el-Mandeb was identified as the affected maritime corridor. Saudi Red Sea oil export routes remained in operation at the time of the declaration. Commercial shipping access across regional energy transit corridors was under concurrent contest.

meta.note: The declaration and realized shipping disruption remain structurally distinct.
